title: Describe an outdoor sport that you haven’t done yet and would like to do in the future. – IELTS MASTER
topic: Talk about a time when you gave advice to someone
supporting_text:
Latest Makkar cue cards with new solutions

1. I am a hyper active person.
2. I like to keep myself busy both physically as well as mentally.
3. For my physical fitness I prefer games such as badminton and cricket, and for my mental growth I resort to reading.
4. Badminton I picked up recently but cricket I have been playing since my childhood.
5. I have always preferred outdoor games over indoor games and there is one more outdoor game that I would like to try my hands at.
6. That game is football.
7. My father is an avid football fan and when I was a kid I used to enjoy watching football matches with him.


8. During that short span of time my father would transform into a completely different person.
9. He is deeply passionate about very few things and football is one of these things, and I believe I have inherited a part of that passion from him.
10. Many of my friends play football in the small park which is situated in the middle of our society.
11. Most of the boys in my society are of my age so I think I would really enjoy playing football with them.
12. I have seen them many times playing football and they seem really close to each and enjoy each other’s company even after play time is over.
13. I think this feeling of togetherness is inherent in the sport since it is a team sport.
14. For me it would be an ideal sport because it would challenge me in a holistic manner.
15. While playing this sport every muscle of the body is involved which is good for overall physical fitness and the continuous coordination required with other teammates makes a person’s brain more alert and sharp.
16. Surely no other sport has as many benefits as football has.
17. I have not yet played this game but I love to watch this sport on TV.
18. I am an ardent supporter of Manchester United football club.
19. I simply love the passion for sport in the UK, not only among the players but in people as well.
20. My uncle is a citizen of the UK and he tells me that football is not a game there, it is a religion, more importantly a way of living there.
21. I really admire Christiano Ronaldo.


22. His football prowess does not need an introduction.
23. And like any other football fan I too have been part of the inevitable debates around who is better between Ronaldo and Messi.
